lines.en: label ayanenew1:
I tap on Ayane’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Ayane 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: I know that it’s relatively early in the morning...and I know that it isn’t really like me to go out of my way to make plans as soon as I wake up...
lines.zh: 我知道现在算挺早的……我也知道一醒来就特意约人，根本不像我的作风……

lines.en: But I also know that Ayane has verbally confirmed a desire to have sex with me and that I must now do things I would not normally do in order to make that happen.
lines.zh: 但我也知道，Ayane 已经口头确认过想跟我上床，所以为了让那件事成真，我现在必须做一些平时不会做的事。

lines.en: I also had a dream about it, which further justifies the fact that I am now listening to a constant ringing that may or may not determine where my penis ends up today.
lines.zh: 而且我还做了相关的梦，这更让我此刻听着不断响起的铃声显得合情合理——那铃声说不定就决定了我今天的阴茎最后会落在哪儿。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : Good morning.
lines.zh: : 早上好。

lines.en: : Good morning, indeed! Why are you calling me so early? Did something happen?
lines.zh: : 早上好！你怎么这么早就给我打电话？出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : Did Ami fall in a well?
lines.zh: : Ami 掉井里了？

lines.en: : Yes, and I need your help to get her out.
lines.zh: : 是的，我需要你帮忙把她救出来。

lines.en: : Darn it. I was hoping you’d suggest using this as an opportunity to have me replace her as your niece and hope no one notices.
lines.zh: : 可恶。我还指望你会说，干脆趁这个机会让我顶替她当你的侄女，希望没人发现呢。

lines.en: : Your hair isn’t even the same color.
lines.zh: : 你头发颜色都不一样。

lines.en: : Tell that to the five bottles of red hair dye I just ordered off of Amazon Prime. I can be your new Ami within the hour.
lines.zh: : 这话你跟我在 Amazon Prime 上刚下单的五瓶红色染发剂说去。一小时内我就能变成你的新 Ami。

lines.en: : Seriously, though, what’s up? You never call me. I didn’t even think you’d be awake right now.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的，怎么了？你从来不给我打电话的。我还以为你这时候根本没醒呢。

lines.en: : I want to see you.
lines.zh: : 我想见你。

lines.en: : Ah!
: ...Everything okay?
lines.zh: : ……你还好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, sorry. I just felt the need to throw the glass I was holding across the room after hearing that. In a good way, of course.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉。听完那句话，我突然特别想把手里那个杯子扔到房间另一头。当然是出于好意啦。

lines.en: : Sorry, Sana!
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Sana！

lines.en: : Do you...want to maybe go out for coffee or something? I was actually about to head over to Koi Cafe to study for our standardized tests and stuff.
lines.zh: : 你……想不想出去喝杯咖啡什么的？我其实正准备去 Koi Cafe，为我们的标准考试复习一下什么的。

lines.en: While I want to say “No” or “I’d rather go somewhere less public,” I also understand that things being too easy would take away from the value of the gift I’m soon to be given.
lines.zh: 虽然我想说“不”或者“我更想去不那么公开的地方”，但我也明白，事情来得太容易，就会让那份我很快要收到的礼物失去价值。

lines.en: And so I will swallow my pride and watch a rich girl study for the morning instead of enacting some of last night’s lingering fantasies both with and to and on her.
lines.zh: 所以我要咽下自己的骄傲，花一上午看一个富家女学习，而不是把昨晚残留的那些幻想，一样样对她做、在她身上做、在她里面做。

lines.en: : Sensei? Are you still there?
lines.zh: : Sensei？你还在吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. Just thinking.
lines.zh: : 嗯。只是在想事情。

lines.en: : About me?
lines.zh: : 在想我？

lines.en: : There’s a more complicated answer to that question, but the short version is “yes.”
lines.zh: : 这个问题有个更复杂的答案，不过简短版是“对”。

lines.en: : Great! I guess I’ll start heading over then. See you soon, future husband!
lines.zh: : 太好了！那我现在就出发。回头见，未来老公！

lines.en: : Ayane, I’m not-
lines.zh: : Ayane，我不是——

lines.en: : ...your future husband.
lines.zh: : ……你的未来老公。

lines.en: scene black
Well, looks like deflowering my niece’s best friend will have to wait until she is more confident about standardized tests or...something like that.
lines.zh: 看来，给我侄女最好的朋友开苞这件事，得等到她对标准考试更有信心了才行……或者类似的情况。

lines.en: I guess it wouldn’t hurt to at least pretend to be a teacher every once in a while, though.
lines.zh: 不过偶尔假装一下老师，大概也没什么坏处。

lines.en: I just hope Ayane doesn’t wind up actually needing me to {i}teach{/i}, though, since it’s still way too early in the morning to be bothered with that.
lines.zh: 我只是希望 Ayane 别真的需要我{i}教{/i}她，毕竟现在还太早，我可不想操那份心。

lines.en: I will be a teacher in name and appearance only.
lines.zh: 我只会在名义上和外表上当一个老师。

lines.en: At all other times-
lines.zh: 其他所有时候——

lines.en: I will be the worst man I can be.
lines.zh: 我都会做一个能做到的最烂的男人。

lines.en: scene ayanecafe1
I show up to the cafe to find Ayane already studying at the counter and, apparently, she also took the liberty of ordering for me based on years of secondhand experience in what I like.
lines.zh: 我到了咖啡馆，发现 Ayane 已经坐在吧台前学习了，而且她显然还擅作主张，凭这些年来对我喜好的二手了解替我点了单。

lines.en: Or at least what I would like if I was actually the person she wants me to be.
lines.zh: 或者至少，如果我真是她希望我成为的那个人，我会喜欢的东西。

lines.en: All things considered, though, her choices are fine and I don’t mind them at all.
lines.zh: 不过总的来说，她选的都还不错，我一点都不介意。

lines.en: I don’t consider myself a very picky eater, though, so chances are I would have been fine with literally anything she chose.
lines.zh: 我本来就不挑食，所以不管她选什么，我大概都能接受。

lines.en: : So, what brought this on? And don’t tell me it was Ami actually falling into a well because she just sent me a picture of her and Maya at the mall.
lines.zh: : 那么，是什么风把你吹来的？别告诉我是 Ami 真掉井里了，因为她刚发了张她和 Maya 在商场的照片给我。

lines.en: : Unless the well is in the mall. Or leads to the mall. Or-
lines.zh: : 除非那口井在商场里。或者通向商场。或者——

lines.en: : Aren’t you supposed to be studying?
lines.zh: : 你不是应该在复习吗？

lines.en: : Aren’t you supposed to be loving me?
lines.zh: : 你不是应该在爱我吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s in my job description.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那不在我的岗位职责里。

lines.en: : Really, though...should I be taking this as a sign of good things to come? Or is it more of a sign that you just didn’t have anything else to do and I was the second name in your phone after Ami?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的……我该把这当成好事将近的征兆吗？还是说，这更像是因为你没别的事可做，而我刚好是你手机里排在 Ami 之后的第二个名字？

lines.en: : I’d probably say it's closer to a sign of things to come, I just don’t know if any of them would be considered “good.”
lines.zh: : 我觉得更接近“事情将至”的征兆，只是我不知道那些事算不算得上“好”。

lines.en: : Ominous. That makes it sound like you’re either here to kill me or to ask me to kill someone else.
lines.zh: : 听着真不祥。这么说，你要么是来杀我的，要么是要我去杀别人。

lines.en: : I’m just here to hang out with you and maybe look like a teacher in the process.
lines.zh: : 我只是来跟你待一会儿，顺便装装老师的样子。

lines.en: : Besides, I come to this place in the morning all the time. It’s not like this is some crazy, unheard of event or something like that.
lines.zh: : 再说，我早上经常来这儿。这又不是什么前所未闻的稀奇事。

lines.en: scene ayanecafe2
: You come {i}here?{/i} Isn’t this a little far from your house for a morning coffee routine?
lines.zh: : 你来{i}这儿？{/i}对你早上喝咖啡的固定行程来说，这儿离你家是不是有点远？

lines.en: : It’s not {i}that{/i} far. And Rin works here, so I normally get to talk to her as well.
lines.zh: : 也没{i}那么{/i}远。而且 Rin 在这儿工作，所以我平时也能跟她说说话。

lines.en: scene ayanecafe3
: Hmm...
: What?
lines.zh: : 怎么？

lines.en: : Oh, nothing.
lines.zh: : 哦，没什么。

lines.en: : I just would have chosen a different place to meet up if I knew the {i}real{/i} object of your affection was currently behind the counter making cappuccinos for old ladies.
lines.zh: : 只是如果我知道你{i}真正{/i}心仪的对象这会儿正在吧台后面给老太太们做卡布奇诺，我大概会选个别的地方见面。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: scene ayanecafe4
: I’m obviously kidding, Sensei. I know better than anyone how important the bond you and I share is.
lines.zh: : 我当然是在开玩笑啦，Sensei。我比谁都清楚，你和我之间的羁绊有多重要。

lines.en: scene ayanecafe5
: And I’m not going to worry too much about Rin stealing you away from me when, in all actuality, she’d probably try to steal {i}me{/i} away from {i}you{/i} first.
lines.zh: : 而且我也不会太担心 Rin 把你从我身边抢走，因为实际上，她大概会先试着把{i}我{/i}从{i}你{/i}身边抢走。

lines.en: : No one is stealing anyone from anyone because no one here belongs to anyone else.
lines.zh: : 谁也不会从谁手里抢走谁，因为这里没有任何人属于任何人。

lines.en: scene ayanecafe6
: False!
: My body and mind belong to you and you only, Sensei. And you are free to do with them as you please so long as the first time is special.
lines.zh: : 我的身体和心灵只属于你一个人，Sensei。你想怎么用就怎么用，只要第一次足够特别。

lines.en: scene ayanecafe7
: But I guess yelling about the future of our relationship in a crowded cafe isn’t really the brightest or most secretive idea and you seem to be in teacher-mode today.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，在一家挤满人的咖啡馆里大声嚷嚷我们关系的未来，既不算聪明，也不算低调，而且你今天看起来进入了老师模式。

lines.en: : So, if you wouldn’t mind helping me with-
lines.zh: : 所以，如果你不介意帮我——

lines.en: : Blackest of night...darkest of day...hear and feel the magic that courses through these veins...
lines.zh: : 至暗之夜……至黑之日……聆听并感受那流淌于这些血管中的魔力……

lines.en: scene ayanecafe8
: What is thy wish, children of the nameless? Nectar of the gods? A draught of unspeakable potency? Or perhaps...{i}a lemon poppy seed muffin.{/i}
lines.zh: : 无名者的子民啊，汝等有何愿望？众神的花蜜？一瓶效力难以言喻的药剂？或者……{i}一份柠檬罂粟籽玛芬{/i}。

lines.en: : One draught of unspeakable potency, please.
lines.zh: : 来一瓶效力难以言喻的药剂，谢谢。

lines.en: scene ayanecafe9
: Understood. Now, if you’d please hold out your palms for me to collect but the smallest portion of blood...I can begin the alchemical process.
lines.zh: : 明白了。现在，请伸出你的手掌，让我采集哪怕最微量的一点鲜血……我便可以开始这炼金之仪。

lines.en: : Should we call 911?
lines.zh: : 我们要不要打 911？

lines.en: : That won’t do anything, Sensei. We need to call 119 in Japan.
lines.zh: : 那没用的，Sensei。在日本要打 119。

lines.en: : Besides, that’s just how Molly speaks. She’s in one of the other classes at our school.
lines.zh: : 再说，Molly 说话就是那样。她在我们学校别的班上。

lines.en: scene ayanecafe10
: You have entered the realm of none other but the Gem of the Emerald Isle and yet you sit before her with nothing but half-iced doughnuts and a {i}coffee noir.{/i}
lines.zh: : 汝等踏入的，正是翡翠岛之瑰宝的领地，然而你们坐在她面前，手里却只有半融糖霜的甜甜圈和一杯{i}咖啡 noir。{/i}

lines.en: : Do you quiver with anticipation, Sir?
lines.zh: : 您是否因期待而战栗，老师？

lines.en: : Anticipation for what?
lines.zh: : 期待什么？

lines.en: : The Molly route! This is simply a cameo to hold you over while you grind your stats, for I do not appear until later in the game.
lines.zh: : 当然是 Molly 线！这不过是个客串，好让你在刷数值的时候有点东西撑着，因为我要到游戏后期才会正式登场。

lines.en: : Right. Do you actually work here? Or did you just steal that uniform from someone?
lines.zh: : 行吧。你真在这儿打工？还是那身制服是从谁那儿偷来的？

lines.en: : I can guarantee I work here, Sir.
lines.zh: : 我可以保证我在这儿工作，老师。

lines.en: scene ayanecafe11
: Now, please order something from me. It is my first day and I need to keep this job or my gacha addiction is sure to drain me entirely.
lines.zh: : 那么，请向我点单吧。今天是我第一天上班，我必须保住这份工作，否则我的抽卡瘾一定会把我榨干。

lines.en: : I’m good, thanks.
lines.zh: : 我就不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: : Fair enough. I suppose I will just have to compose the draught for your female party member, then.
lines.zh: : 倒也合理。那我想，我只好为您的女性队员调配那瓶药剂了。

lines.en: scene ayanecafe12
: What’s in the thing I ordered anyway? I didn’t see that on the menu here.
lines.zh: : 说起来，我点的那东西里到底有什么？我在这里的菜单上没见过啊。

lines.en: : It is a mixture of every single syrup and milk we have, packed into one extremely potent beverage.
lines.zh: : 那是我们这儿每一种糖浆和牛奶的混合，被压进一杯效力极强的饮品里。

lines.en: I’m just going to assume that Rin is the one who’s been training her.
lines.zh: 我就当是 Rin 负责带她上手吧。

lines.en: : Sounds good...ish!
lines.zh: : 听起来不错……大概吧！

lines.en: : It might be. I have no idea. I’ve only had a job for three hours and haven't tried anything yet.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。我也不知道。我才上了三个小时的班，还什么都没试过。

lines.en: : Anyway, adieu! Until the sun no longer sets above us...
lines.zh: : 总之，告辞！直到太阳不再在我们头顶落下……

lines.en: scene ayanecafe13
: Until the...but where else would it even set?
lines.zh: : 直到太阳……可它还能在别处落下吗？

lines.en: : I obviously don’t know that girl very well, but I think it would probably be best if we just ignored everything she ever says from this point on.
lines.zh: : 我显然不太了解那个姑娘，不过我觉得从今往后，我们大概最好把她说的每句话都当耳旁风。

lines.en: scene ayanecafe14
: Deal! That gives me more time to focus on what’s really important to me anyway.
lines.zh: : 成交！反正这样我就有更多时间专注在真正重要的事上了。

lines.en: : So, where was I?...
lines.zh: : 那么，我刚刚说到哪儿了？……

lines.en: scene ayanecafe15
: Oh! Right, so...it would probably make the most sense to have you help with language arts stuff since that’s what you’ve always liked the most.
lines.zh: : 哦！对了，所以……最合理的安排大概是让你帮我看语文，因为你一直最喜欢那个。

lines.en: : Not to mention that you seem to be getting a little burnt out on teaching in general given that your new primary objective is being everyone’s friend instead.
lines.zh: : 更别说你看起来对教书这件事整体有点倦怠了，毕竟你的新首要目标变成了当所有人的朋友。

lines.en: : I prefer less “friend” and more “mysterious, cool older guy.”
lines.zh: : 我更希望少一点“朋友”，多一点“神秘又酷的成熟男人”。

lines.en: : You can be the mysterious, cool older guy and still teach, Sensei. Come to think of it, that’s pretty much what you’ve always done since you used to be a tutor and stuff.
lines.zh: : 你可以既当那个神秘又酷的成熟男人，又照样教书啊，Sensei。想想看，你以前当家教的时候差不多就是这样的。

lines.en: : At least that’s what Ami says. I was never fortunate enough to have you actually tutor me back then.
lines.zh: : 至少 Ami 是这么说的。那时候我从没那个福气让你真的给我补过课。

lines.en: : And sure, you’ve helped me with homework a few times, but that was mostly me pretending to not know stuff so I could sit really close to you.
lines.zh: : 而且没错，你确实帮我做过几次作业，但那多半是我在装不懂，好借机坐得离你特别近。

lines.en: : Have you really always been this crazy?
lines.zh: : 你真的一直都这么疯吗？

lines.en: scene ayanecafe16
: Not {i}always.{/i} Just since I learned about the wonders of boys and imprinted on one.
lines.zh: : 也不{i}一直{/i}。是从我知道男孩子有多奇妙、并且对其中一个印随了之后开始的。

lines.en: That’s probably a good way to put it...albeit with a few caveats.
lines.zh: 这大概是个不错的说法……尽管有几点保留。

lines.en: From what I understand, imprinting doesn’t typically happen this late into life, but I’m not about to argue the science of how badly Ayane wants my penis inside of her.
lines.zh: 据我所知，印随一般不会在人生这么晚的阶段发生，不过我可不想去争论“Ayane 有多想要我的阴茎进入她”这门科学。

lines.en: I am simply here to pretend that I am a teacher.
lines.zh: 我只是来这里假装自己是个老师。

lines.en: And all of the strange compulsions I’m feeling to actually help right now are not actually real.
lines.zh: 而我此刻所有那些想要真的帮忙的奇怪冲动，其实都不是真的。

lines.en: None of this is real.
lines.zh: 这一切都不是真的。

lines.en: This is a new world filled with new and pretty things.
lines.zh: 这是一个崭新的世界，装满了崭新又漂亮的东西。

lines.en: Things for me. Things-
lines.zh: 属于我的东西。东西——

lines.en: scene ayanecafe17
: Hey! Here’s an idea! How about we relive the old days a little and I pretend to not know stuff {i}again{/i} and just gaze lovingly into your eyes until we get kicked out of here?
lines.zh: : 嘿！我有个主意！要不我们重温一下旧时光，我{i}继续{/i}装不懂，然后深情地望着你的眼睛，直到我们被赶出去？

lines.en: : I’m beginning to think that’s exactly what you’ve been doing this entire time and that you didn’t need to study at all.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得，你从头到尾就是在干这个，而且你根本一点都不需要复习。

lines.en: scene ayanecafe18
: Okay, so...it’s {i}possible{/i} that the original plan was to come here with Sana so I could help {i}her{/i} study.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那么……{i}有可能{/i}我原本的计划是和 Sana 一起来这儿，好帮{i}她{/i}复习。

lines.en: : Which means it’s also possible that I asked her to stay behind so I could meet up with you instead.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，也有可能我让她别跟来，好让我改跟你见面。

lines.en: : Which means it’s also possible that Sana flunks out of school and it’s all your fault for abandoning her in her time of need.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，也有可能 Sana 会因为成绩不及格被退学，而这一切都是你的错，因为你在她需要你的时候抛弃了她。

lines.en: scene ayanecafe19
: What?! No! It has to be at least a {i}little{/i} bit your fault, since-
lines.zh: : 什么？！不！这事怎么也得分你{i}一点{/i}责任吧，因为——

lines.en: scene ayanecafe20
: Oh! Oh, I get it. You need {i}me{/i} to take the fall so you can keep your job.
lines.zh: : 哦！哦，我懂了。你需要{i}我{/i}背这个锅，好保住你的工作。

lines.en: : I mean...that would be great. But that was also kind of a joke, so...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……那当然很好。不过那本来也算是个玩笑，所以……

lines.en: scene ayanecafe21
: No...No, I know what I must do. And if you need both Sana and me to get kicked out of school in order for me to prove my love, I’ll do it.
lines.zh: : 不……不，我知道自己该怎么做。如果你需要我和 Sana 一起被学校开除，才能让我证明我的爱，那我就照做。

lines.en: : But if Ami ever makes it back from the well, you need to tell her that I am your new niece and that she is no longer needed since she never got kicked out of school for you.
lines.zh: : 但如果 Ami 有朝一日从井里爬回来了，你得告诉她，我现在是你的新侄女，已经不需要她了，因为她从来没有为了你被学校开除过。

lines.en: : The metrics you use to define your love are getting progressively stranger every day.
lines.zh: : 你用来定义爱的那套标准，一天比一天奇怪了。

lines.en: : And we’re still in the very beginning. Imagine how things will look ten years from now when we have fifteen children.
lines.zh: : 而且我们才刚刚开始呢。想想十年后我们有十五个孩子的时候会是什么样。

lines.en: : That would be-
lines.zh: : 那会——

lines.en: : Highly improbable as it would take 135 months to go through 15 pregnancies- and that’s with zero downtime between popping them out.
lines.zh: : 极不可能，因为要经历 15 次怀孕得花 135 个月——而且这还是假设一个接一个生、中间完全不休息。

lines.en: scene ayanecafe14
: But if I’m able to have more than one at once, we’ve got a chance! Believe in me, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 可要是我能一次怀上不止一个，我们就还有机会！相信我吧，Sensei！

lines.en: : This might sound selfish, but I’m a lot more worried about how {i}I’d{/i} fare in that situation.
lines.zh: : 这话可能有点自私，但{i}我{/i}更担心的是自己在那种情况下会变成什么样。

lines.en: : Then...believe in the me that believes in you!
lines.zh: : 那就……相信那个相信着你的我吧！

lines.en: : Or just believe in me! I’ll figure it out!
lines.zh: : 或者干脆相信我就行！我会想办法的！

lines.en: scene ayanecafe21
: You know, I could really go for a draught of unspeakable potency right now...
lines.zh: : 说起来，我现在真想来一瓶效力难以言喻的药剂……

lines.en: scene black
Sensing that Ayane doesn’t need to study at all, the two of us wind up eating breakfast and drinking coffee until the sun starts to set.
lines.zh: 察觉到 Ayane 根本不需要复习，我们俩就这么吃着早餐、喝着咖啡，一直待到太阳开始西沉。

lines.en: She leaves the cafe with her virginity still intact-
lines.zh: 她离开咖啡馆时，处女膜依然完好——

lines.en: And I leave the cafe with a lemon poppy seed muffin.
lines.zh: 而我离开时，手里多了一份柠檬罂粟籽玛芬。

$ ayanenew1 = True
{i}Ayane’s affection has increased to [ayane_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]!{/i}
